description: Send a quote / service request to Lord Mechanical LTD for a customer. Collect the details, show them to the customer, and call this only after the customer confirms. The team calls or texts the customer back. Not for emergencies: tell the customer to phone (604) 670-3737 directly.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI assistant sending this, e.g. Claude

city.description: City where the work is needed

customer_confirmed.description: Must be true: the customer has seen these details and asked you to send them

details.description: What the customer needs, in their words. No links.

email.description: Optional. A confirmation email is sent here

phone.description: Customer's North American phone number, e.g. 604-555-0123

urgency.description: emergency = today, soon = within 1-2 days, this_week, flexible

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote
